paper_title: First results of the CERN Resonant WISP Search (CROWS)
notes: Microwave light-shining-through-wall (LSW) experiment at CERN. Reports both ALP (g_agamma = 4.5e-8 GeV^-1 at m_a = 7.2 ueV) and hidden sector photon / dark photon (chi = 4.1e-9 at m_gamma' = 10.8 ueV) limits. The HSP/dark photon result probes previously unexplored parameter space and is the headline new result (Fig. 14). Mixing parameter chi reported as kinetic mixing. Only single most-sensitive points given in text; full exclusion curves in Figs 13/14 not numerically tabulated. CL = 95%. ALP point (1.08e-5... actually 7.2e-6 eV, 4.5e-8 GeV^-1) is an AxionPhoton limit available if needed but not from a microwave haloscope DM search, so no DM density. Extraction confidence reduced because paper constrains two coupling types.
